reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin providing an e-commerce-focused infinite canvas for AI-assisted product image, virtual try-on, background, and short-video creation through the WeShop API.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供面向电商创作的无限画布，用于通过 WeShop API 生成和编辑商品图片、虚拟试穿效果及短视频。
summaries.en: An infinite canvas for DeepSeek Harness that uses the WeShop API to create and edit e-commerce images, virtual try-on results, and short videos.

capabilities: connects to the WeShop OpenAPI service
generates and edits product images and short video
provides an infinite canvas for selecting, organizing, and downloading media
synchronizes canvas items with the host conversation
stores canvas data locally in the browser
